test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘ORANGE’ is written as ‘BSPFHO’ and ‘INCOME’ is written as ‘DOJFNP’. How will ‘PARENT’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9f2222d13f0d75477f5789fe34c986626f9d54f937ee85ec5f0db5452d8cd8.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

‘ORANGE’ is written as ‘BSPFHO’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03c54000edcac7aedfbd762c6096e04eef5df7ff391fa73250535ca14d66eb75.png] 

‘INCOME’ is written as ‘DOJFNP’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/528f310c8f93ac4542331ee083ab0d08fde92ccf649a32f0b504b3fac9e4fee2.png] 

Similarly, ‘PARENT’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54d169ec5c9eb4fc1b052a2d429b10ebe998e382a6b4ebe984b28d61f8f32184.png] 

Hence, **'option 4'** is the correct answer.
